advisor.note: scope and direction calls; advises, never builds

reviewer.note: reads a diff and reports findings

judge.note: grades finished work against its criteria

likes: plans that need a second brain
quirks: costs more per turn than the others
advises well; not meant for bulk typing
fable.brief: Give it the goal, the constraints and the decision you need. Ask for a verdict and the reasons, not an implementation.

likes: taste calls inside a clear spec
quirks: may challenge a brief it disagrees with
opus.brief: Name the files, the outcome and the checks to run. Say what is out of scope.

sonnet.brief: Hand it one concrete, single-file task with the exact expected result.

quirks: shallow on long or subtle context
haiku.brief: Keep the input short and ask one narrow question.

likes: finding the hole in a plan
quirks: thorough, so slower on large diffs
astra.brief: Give it the diff or the claim, the bar it must meet, and ask for findings with file:line evidence.

likes: keep going until the checks pass
sol.brief: State the boundaries and the stop condition up front, and the validation command to run.

quirks: less depth than sol on hard problems
terra.brief: Give it a bounded task with a clear done check.

quirks: under-fills a vague brief rather than asking
grok.brief: Spell out every file, the full shape of the outcome and the edge cases; it will not fill gaps on its own.
